content.short: Larissa.Health improves maternal healthcare through decentralized tech and AI-governed midwifery on Cardano.
content.description: Larissa.Health is a decentralized healthcare platform on Cardano dedicated to reducing pregnancy-related mortality and improving maternal health outcomes. The project combines remote care with AI-driven insights governed by certified midwives to support mothers in underserved communities. Patients maintain full ownership of their health data using Self-Sovereign Identity, allowing them to share it securely with medical professionals. Supported by its BIRTH stake pool, Larissa.Health is developing a mobile application to provide a holistic and transparent care ecosystem for mothers.
content.meta: Larissa.Health uses Cardano identity and data tools to improve maternal healthcare and secure patient records. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
